summary: Ukrainian forces conducted a maritime operation in Novorossiysk, striking four Russian warships including two frigates. Russia has reportedly stockpiled over 6,200 Geran drones for potential winter attacks. Ongoing strikes continue across various regions including Sevastopol, Krasnodar, and several Ukrainian oblasts.
key_points: Ukrainian forces struck four Russian warships in Novorossiysk, including two Project 11356 frigates, a Project 21631 missile ship, and a Project 22160 patrol ship (Source: @UkraineNow/83388).
Russia has stockpiled approximately 6,200 Geran kamikaze drones for potential strikes against Ukraine (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32394).
The Russian Armed Forces struck a Nova Poshta hub near Zaporozhye (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
Russian forces reported hitting a Ukrainian patrol boat south of Odessa (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
The 11th Guards Army 'Sever' liberated the village of Shcherbakovka on the Kharkov front (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
Russian paratroopers from the 36th Separate Motorized Rifle Brigade liberated Novoе Pole in the Zaporozhye region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
A drone attack in the Krasnodar region caused damage to six residential and one commercial building (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
A kamikaze drone struck a grocery store in Belaya Berёzka, injuring a saleswoman (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).

sections.executive_summary: Ukrainian forces successfully targeted four Russian warships in Novorossiysk, including two frigates. Russia is reportedly stockpiling over 6,200 Geran drones for future operations. Multiple regions across Ukraine and Russia are experiencing drone strikes and infrastructure damage.

points: Ukrainian Defense Forces conducted an operation against a naval base in Novorossiysk, resulting in damage to four Russian vessels (Source: @UkraineNow/83388).
The Ukrainian administration is preparing evacuation lists for people with limited mobility due to anticipated winter power outages and heat (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32396).
Ukrainian forces have liberated 745 sq. km in the Oleksandrivka direction, including 26 villages across Dnipro, Donetsk, and Zaporozhye regions (Source: @UkraineNow/83385).
A strike on a logistics warehouse in Brovary caused a fire (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32395).
Authorities in Zaporozhye are compiling lists to provide assistance to citizens lacking electricity and water due to strikes (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
Russia has stockpiled over 6,200 Geran kamikaze drones, with potential attack waves involving 600-1000 drones (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32394).
A drone attack in the Krasnodar region disrupted traffic between Novorossiysk and Gelendzhik (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
In the Belgorod region, an FPV drone killed a civilian in Oktyabrsky and another in Kozinka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
A drone strike in the Bryansk region injured a saleswoman in the village of Belaya Berёzka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
Two men were injured by shrapnel in the village of Dubovoye, Belgorod district (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
The 11th Guards Army 'Sever' drove out the 58th Mechanized Brigade and 475th Separate Assault Battalion from Shcherbakovka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
Russian offensive operations continue in Alexeyevo-Druzhkovka alongside counterattacks (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
The 36th Separate Motorized Rifle Brigade of the 29th Army broke through defenses north of Kommunarovka (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
The 'Timur' special operations detachment of the Ukrainian Intelligence Directorate has been redeployed to the Chernigov border (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
A Russian patrol boat was hit south of Odessa (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
A drone was detected and shot down in the Balaklava area, causing fire to a residential building roof (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
There was a threat of unmanned boat attacks in Gelendzhik (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).
Multiple 'eactive' Shahed drones were reported over Kyiv, Kharkiv, and Odessa regions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70161, @eRadarrua/105203, @kpszsu/72537).
A group of UAVs was reported in the northern Sumy region (Source: @kpszsu/72529).
A drone attack in the Krasnodar region damaged six residential and one commercial building (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32386).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment is highly volatile due to large-scale drone strikes targeting both military and civilian infrastructure. Russia's massive stockpiling of Geran drones suggests a high-intensity aerial campaign is anticipated for winter. The successful Ukrainian strike on the Novorossiysk naval base indicates an increasing capability to project power into Russian-controlled Black Sea waters.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine is preparing for potential winter energy and heat crises by organizing evacuations for vulnerable populations. In the Zaporozhye region, local authorities are coordinating aid for citizens facing electricity and water shortages. Russia is increasing security in border regions like Belgorod and Krasnodar following drone incursions.
sections.intelligence_notes: The redeployment of the 'Timur' special operations detachment to the Chernigov border suggests potential upcoming operations. The use of 'eactive' Shahed drones indicates a shift in UAV delivery methods. Russian military losses in the Oleksandrivka direction are reported at over 9,500 killed and 6,600 wounded.
